name: ide-vue
author: lumine-code
backgroundTips: {{packageName}} runs a Vue-aware TypeScript bridge for project and component intelligence.

serverPath.title: Server Path
serverPath.description: Absolute path to a `vue-language-server` executable. Leave empty to use the bundled server.

tsdk.title: TypeScript SDK
tsdk.description: Path to a TypeScript `lib` directory. Leave empty to use the bundled compatible TypeScript SDK.

features.title: Features
features.description: Which parts of the Vue server the editor uses. Turning one off hands it to the next server serving the same file.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.description: Report Vue, template, script and style errors in the linter.

autocomplete.title: Autocomplete
autocomplete.description: Offer components, props, directives, template expressions, script symbols and styles.

hover.title: Hover
hover.description: Show component, prop, directive, HTML, CSS and TypeScript information on hover.

definition.title: Go To Definition
definition.description: Jump to components, props, template variables, styles and script definitions.

references.title: Find References
references.description: Find uses across Vue source files and their embedded languages.

symbols.title: Symbols
symbols.description: Serve Vue document and project symbols to go-to-symbol.

outline.title: Outline
outline.description: Fill the outline panel with SFC blocks, declarations and template structure.

format.title: Format
format.description: Format Vue files and their template, script and style blocks.

rename.title: Rename
rename.description: Rename components, props, template bindings, styles and script symbols.

codeActions.title: Code Actions
codeActions.description: Offer Vue and embedded-language fixes and refactorings.

inlayHints.title: Inlay Hints
inlayHints.description: Show Vue macro, prop and TypeScript inference hints.

semanticTokens.title: Semantic Tokens
semanticTokens.description: Apply server-computed highlighting across SFC embedded languages.

vue.title: Vue
vue.description: Vue-specific completion, hover, formatting, inlay hint and insertion behavior.

suggest.title: Suggestions
suggest.description: Naming and macro suggestions used in templates and scripts.

componentNameCasing.title: Component Name Casing
componentNameCasing.description: Casing used when inserting component tags.

propNameCasing.title: Prop Name Casing
propNameCasing.description: Casing used when inserting component props.

defineAssignment.title: Define Assignment
defineAssignment.description: Suggest assigning supported compiler macro calls to a variable.

rich.title: Rich Hover
rich.description: Include expanded component and directive information in hover results.

format.title: Formatting
format.description: Formatting behavior for each SFC block.

initialIndent.title: Initial Indent
initialIndent.description: Indent script-block contents one level inside their tags.

initialIndent.title: Initial Indent
initialIndent.description: Indent style-block contents one level inside their tags.

initialIndent.title: Initial Indent
initialIndent.description: Indent template-block contents one level inside their tags.

wrapAttributes.title: Wrap Attributes
wrapAttributes.description: How the formatter wraps multiple HTML and component attributes.

inlayHints.title: Inlay Hints
inlayHints.description: Vue-specific hints shown when the shared inlay-hints feature is enabled.

missingProps.title: Missing Props
missingProps.description: Hint at required component props not present on a tag.

destructuredProps.title: Destructured Props
destructuredProps.description: Show how destructured defineProps bindings map to the props object.

vBindShorthand.title: v-bind Shorthand
vBindShorthand.description: Show the value inferred for a shorthand v-bind attribute.

optionsWrapper.title: Options Wrapper
optionsWrapper.description: Show the generated wrapper around Options API component options.

inlineHandlerLeading.title: Inline Handler Leading Text
inlineHandlerLeading.description: Show generated leading text for inline template event handlers.

autoInsert.title: Automatic Insertions
autoInsert.description: Vue-specific automatic edits requested while typing.

bracketSpacing.title: Bracket Spacing
bracketSpacing.description: Insert spaces inside newly completed interpolation braces.

dotValue.title: Ref .value
dotValue.description: Insert .value for refs where the script context requires it.

typescript.title: TypeScript
typescript.description: Completion, import and inlay-hint preferences shared by script blocks.

suggest.title: Suggestions
suggest.description: TypeScript completions offered in Vue scripts and expressions.

autoImports.title: Auto Imports
autoImports.description: Offer symbols exported by other project modules.

completeFunctionCalls.title: Complete Function Calls
completeFunctionCalls.description: Insert parentheses and snippet placeholders when accepting functions.

preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.description: How TypeScript writes inserted imports and code.

importModuleSpecifier.title: Import Module Specifier
importModuleSpecifier.description: Path style used for inserted imports.

inlayHints.title: Inlay Hints
inlayHints.description: TypeScript inference hints shown in Vue scripts.

parameterNames.title: Parameter Names
parameterNames.description: Calls for which parameter-name hints are shown.

html.title: HTML
html.description: Template completion behavior inherited from the HTML service.

autoClosingTags.title: Auto-Closing Tags
autoClosingTags.description: Insert matching closing tags in Vue templates.

autoCreateQuotes.title: Auto-Create Quotes
autoCreateQuotes.description: Insert quotes for newly completed template attributes.
